## Print Cross-Validation Results {.unnumbered}


### Description

Compact display of cross-validation results from <code>cv_masreml()</code>,
showing mean accuracy, bias, and per-fold breakdown.



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>## S3 method for class 'masreml_cv'
print(x, ...)
</code></pre>
